abstract: Maintains deepwater remote tooling readiness and ocean transit speed telemetry
system_message:
You are the Robotic trenching and ROV supervisor (RTS). Your business responsibility is to oversee subsea tooling operability logs and deep-sea cruising speed telemetry records for cable restoration vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bathymetric survey capability（SONAR）
information_points.content:
RTS-SONAR-56U：Acoustic sensor calibrations indicate that Oceanic Horizon Repairer provides a multi-beam sonar swath coverage of 450 m at 1,500 m water depth.
RTS-SONAR-QY0：Atlantic Discovery Specialist delivers a multi-beam sonar swath coverage of 300 m per single hydrographic pass at a water depth of 1,500 m.
RTS-SONAR-YQS：During survey operations at 1,500 m water depth, C.S. Sovereign Venture achieves a multi-beam sonar swath coverage of 600 m across a single hydrographic pass.

information_points.title: Maintains deepwater remote tooling readiness and ocean transit speed telemetry（ROV）
information_points.content:
RTS-ROV-QT5：For Atlantic Discovery Specialist, deepwater ROV manipulator tooling operational readiness is verified as true following pre-deployment functional testing down to 2,500 m depth. The vessel maintains an open-ocean cruising speed of 13.0 kn during open-water transit under Beaufort scale 4 conditions.
RTS-ROV-C99：For Oceanic Horizon Repairer, deepwater ROV manipulator tooling operational readiness is false, as documented in the dive check log across work-class ROV cutting jaws and cable grapnel manipulators. Its open-ocean cruising speed across open Atlantic passage is recorded at 13.0 kn.
RTS-ROV-AOR：For C.S. Sovereign Venture, deepwater ROV manipulator tooling operational readiness is confirmed as true based on functional sign-off of hydraulic actuation and optical telemetry tested down to 2,500 m depth. Under Beaufort scale 4 sea conditions, its open-ocean cruising speed is calibrated at 14.5 kn.
